name: nanobot-canonical-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is nanobot, a lightweight personal AI agent framework. This task covers its
configuration (the config file schema, defaults, `${VAR}` environment references and instance paths), the cron
service behind scheduled automations, local triggers and their delivery queue, the slash-command router and built-in
chat commands, session storage, pairing, the network and workspace security helpers, the message bus, and the shared
utilities.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is these Python modules of the nanobot package: nanobot/config_base.py and every module in nanobot/config/, nanobot/cron/, nanobot/command/, nanobot/session/, nanobot/security/, nanobot/pairing/, nanobot/triggers/, nanobot/bus/ and nanobot/utils/. Together with them, the documentation pages docs/configuration.md, docs/chat-commands.md, docs/automations.md and docs/multiple-instances.md, and the module, class and function docstrings of the in-scope modules.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
authority: change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit
or delete documentation to make a disagreement go away. The documentation is those pages and the
in-package docstrings, including their examples; in-package code comments are only supporting
evidence, and when a comment conflicts with the documentation, follow the documentation.
